Stay vigilant.|audio = ContainmentWave1.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 1 ([[Containment]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hex Spawn''' was the first enemy to appear in [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]] alongside the [[Hex Minion]]. It had a decent amount of health and an above average speed. On some waves, it could spawn with [[Bloated]] or [[Aggro]]. ==Appearance== The '''Hex Spawn''' had a light maroon skin with multiple red veins. It also wore grey pieces of armor, consisting of shoulder-pads, chestplate and short, alongside brown knee-pads and a belt. Multiple red crystals could be seen on its armor. ==Strategy== *Strong early-game towers like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Militant]], [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Soldier]] can be used to kill this quickly. *The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] can be useful here, as it can kill multiple of them with its flames. *On some waves, the '''Hex Spawn''' will spawn with [[Aggro]], making it force towers to target it. **Towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful here. **The [[Trapper]] can be useful in such situations, as while it will still target it, its traps will damage any enemies that get past the [[Aggro]] '''Hex Spawns'''. Similarly, unit collisions can also be effective. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} HexscapeNight2Thumbnail.png|'''Hex Spawn''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} HexscapeNight2DiscordThumbnail.png|'''Hex Spawn''' on a render. }} ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Hex Spawn''' added. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Hex Spawn''' now appears in [[Containment]]. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Hex Spawn''' removed. {{TheNightmareRealm|Start|N/A|Hex Spawn & [[Hex Minion]]|Wave 1|[[Hex Wraith]]|Wave 2}} {{Containment|Start|N/A|Hex Spawn & [[Hex Minion]]|Wave 1|[[Hex Wraith]]|Wave 2}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
